source_mechanic: TRG-088 documents Lidar Topdown, Lidar Cuboid Annotation, synchronized camera imagery, persistent cuboids across frames, and 2D/3D Lidar Linking evaluated by 3D IoU and link correctness.
original_transformation: This benchmark builds a self-contained toy transport depot from procedural oriented boxes, locally generated point samples, and three affine camera views. It keeps the cross-modal cuboid-fit and identity-link loop while using original geometry, labels, colors, and browser controls; it is not a Scale API wrapper and does not copy source media.
assets: All visible art is generated by the local canvases and CSS. No third-party raster or presentation asset is shipped.
license_note: The cited API/schema pages are provenance references only; this environment does not redistribute their code or media.
